description:
Lists of names.

Recto: Hārūn; Binyamin he-Ḥasid; Aharon ("the deceased"); [...]; Binyamin; Elʿazar; Moshe; Hillel; Binyamin; [...]; Avraham; Petaḥya; Hillel; Shelomo; Yeshuʿa; Avraham; Yiṣḥaq; Avraham; Berakhot; Ḥalfon; Aharon; Elʿazar; Zekharya; Yeshuʿa; Elʿazar. 

The first entry on verso ends with Maṣliaḥ and Yehuda. The next may be headed "Baghdādī": Avraham; Yiṣḥaq; Shelomo; Yakhin; Saʿadya; Yakhin; Saʿadya; Menashshe; Yefet; Yosef; Yakhin; Mevasser; ʿEli; Saʿadya; Yakhin ha-Rofeʾ; [...] ha-Sar ha-Nikhbad; Mevasser; [...] ha-Ḥazzan.
